title: Hook Bindings
description: Formalizes the STRUCTURE of hooks/hooks.json — the single file holding all of the plugin's real Claude Code hook bindings (see CLAUDE.md's 'Command and Hook Mechanics' section). A hooks file is a top-level object with an optional '_meta' documentation block and a mandatory 'hooks' map. The 'hooks' map's keys are valid Claude Code hook events; each event maps to an array of entries; each entry has a 'matcher' (tool name or regex) and a 'hooks' array of handlers; each handler declares a 'type' (command | prompt | agent) and carries the field that type needs — a 'command' handler names a script path, a 'prompt' handler carries a 'prompt' string, an 'agent' handler carries a 'prompt' that drives a subagent. This is a shape-only schema (P1 Governance Foundation): it validates structure, not the runtime behaviour of any hook.

_meta.description: Human-facing documentation block. Not read by Claude Code's hook loader; carries purpose/provenance notes.

hooks.description: Map of hook event name to the list of entries bound to that event. Same schema as the 'hooks' key in settings.json.

propertyNames.description: Only real Claude Code hook events are permitted as keys — no invented events (see CLAUDE.md: no before-file-create/after-agent events ever existed).

additionalProperties.description: The entries bound to one event. Each entry pairs a matcher with one or more handlers.

entry.description: A single hook binding: a matcher plus the handlers that run when a matching tool is used.

matcher.description: Tool name or regex the event is scoped to (e.g. 'Write', 'Write|Edit', 'Agent').

hooks.description: The ordered list of handlers to run for this entry.

handler.description: One handler within an entry. Its 'type' selects which delivery field it must carry.

type.description: The handler mechanism: 'command' runs a script (JSON on stdin, exit code = allow/block); 'prompt' is a single-turn LLM judgment; 'agent' is a full subagent driven by a prompt.

command.description: Path to the script a 'command' handler runs (typically under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/).

prompt.description: The instruction a 'prompt' or 'agent' handler is invoked with.
